description: Verify that Length field longer than UDP datagram — DUT must reject or ignore
approach:
[Objective]
If SOME/IP Length declares more bytes than the UDP datagram carries, the message is malformed — DUT rejects (no OK Response).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: Method Request (per-case shape).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: Method Response (or absence) per the asserted behaviour.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted response satisfies the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase2_dut_accepted_malformed: DUT returned OK Response for oversized length field
